brief: Clear the radiator fins heavily fouled with dust and pollen, airflow visibly reduced, and remove the site storage placed against the ventilation opening on the east side [MG-021]. The supplied documents do not provide procedural guidance for addressing the radiator fouling or ventilation obstruction beyond restoring full cooling capacity [MG-021]. Because this ageing unit cannot be restored to full cooling prior to the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 [MG-023].
